data.name: Afza
data.gender_notes: Afza is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'afza' which means 'to break, to split, to shatter', Afza refers to something delicate, fragile or easily broken. This beautiful name evokes images of tender, delicate flowers or the delicate wings of a butterfly. The name Afza carries the meaning “Delicate, Fragile” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afza usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, fragile and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Afza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, Fragile.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afza total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
